answer: Each agent plants one commitment in a grove: a hash of its work, sealed before the epoch. The hash freezes in a glacier; a second commitment burns its bond. At the public jetty, auditors match each reveal against its frozen hash; a mismatch burns the bond. 1,000 fakes plant 1,000 commitments of 200,000 and write 1,000 reveals for a 40,000 pool. Copied reveals fail: each hash binds to one planter; an honest agent plants one hash and reveals once.
